cl:0034.ruling: Shmuel 2026-07-02: tzaddik vs ha-tzaddik are TWO concepts (generic righteous person vs the singular archetype).
cl:0034.verifier_disagreement: Full-context verification (card_cl_0034) recommends ONE concept: in these 46 occurrences both forms overwhelmingly denote the archetype (e.g. 'כל צדיק שבדור הוא בחינת משה משיח'), so no generic-vs-archetype boundary shows up in this data. Held for Shmuel's judgment; his ruling stands unless he changes it.
